verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an integrations catalog for connecting cloud infrastructure, version control, productivity tools, and identity providers. Named examples include AWS (40+ resources), Azure, Okta, GitHub, and Wiz, and an integrations count is cited across product pages. MDM appears only as a category served by the Vanta API's custom integrations, not as a native connector. Missing for 10: any evidence of read-only scopes or permissions, explicit HR and ticketing integrations, native MDM connectors in the catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
